subject: [PATCH 2/3] perf/core: Don't let BPF programs read an uninitialized sample address

reviews.author: tip-bot2 for Usama Arif
reviews.summary: The patch has been merged into the perf/urgent branch of tip, indicating that it is being actively reviewed and considered for inclusion in the mainline kernel.

2026-11-19.patch_summary: This patch series addresses a perf/core issue where BPF programs can read uninitialized sample addresses, potentially leading to security vulnerabilities. The fix involves clearing the address before running the program if nobody filled it in, similar to the SIGTRAP path.
